statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r, the following holds. If no valid transformation sequence exists, then r = 0. If a valid transformation sequence exists, then r > 0, there is a valid transformation sequence with exactly r words, and every valid transformation sequence has at least r words. A valid transformation sequence is a finite sequence of byte arrays w[0],...,w[m-1] with m >= 1 such that w[0] = beginWord, w[m-1] = endWord, for each i with 0 <= i < m-1 the arrays w[i] and w[i+1] have equal length and differ at exactly one index (there is j with 0 <= j < len(w[i]) such that w[i][j] != w[i+1][j] and w[i][t] = w[i+1][t] for every t != j), and for each i with 1 <= i < m there is k with 0 <= k < len(wordList) and w[i] = wordList[k]. Its number of words is m.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and for all i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(wordList), wordList[i] != wordList[j].

statement: ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r; in particular it does not fail, overflow, panic, or get stuck on any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r, 0 <= r <= len(wordList) + 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r and r != 0, r >= 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r, if there is no index i with 0 <= i < len(wordList) such that wordList[i] = endWord, then r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r, if for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), wordList[i] and beginWord do not differ at exactly one index (that is, they are equal, have different lengths, or differ at two or more indices), then r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r, if endWord occurs in wordList and beginWord and endWord differ at exactly one index, then r = 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns a result r with r > 0, there exists a valid transformation sequence w[0],...,w[r-1] with exactly r words such that w[0] = beginWord, w[r-1] = endWord, each adjacent pair w[i], w[i+1] differs at exactly one index, each w[i] with 1 <= i < r occurs in wordList, and the r words w[0],...,w[r-1] are pairwise distinct.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); 1 <= len(wordList) <= 5000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(wordList), len(wordList[i]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and every wordList[i] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns r and ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList') returns r', it holds that r' = r.
preconditions: The constraints of spec_1 hold for (beginWord, endWord, wordList); wordList' is a slice of byte-vector words satisfying the same constraints with respect to beginWord and endWord; and wordList' is a permutation of wordList (the two slices have the same multiset of byte arrays).

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns r and ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList') returns r', if r > 0 then r' > 0 and r' <= r.
preconditions: The constraints of spec_1 hold for (beginWord, endWord, wordList); wordList' is a slice of byte-vector words satisfying the same constraints with respect to beginWord and endWord; and every byte array occurring as an entry of wordList also occurs as an entry of wordList'.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns r and ladder_length(endWord, beginWord, wordList) returns r', it holds that r' = r.
preconditions: The constraints of spec_1 hold for (beginWord, endWord, wordList); wordList contains beginWord and wordList contains endWord.

statement: Whenever ladder_length(beginWord, endWord, wordList) returns r, if wordList[0] = endWord and beginWord and wordList[0] differ at exactly one index, then r = 2; otherwise r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(beginWord) <= 10; len(endWord) = len(beginWord); len(wordList) = 1; len(wordList[0]) = len(beginWord); beginWord, endWord, and wordList[0] consist only of bytes 97 through 122 (lowercase English letters); beginWord != endWord; and all wordList entries are pairwise distinct.
